The tool-generator cross-contamination trace, 2026-08-21: site_work_items row cc1db035 (handler_agent=tool-generator) carries result.commit_sha=9d83d312... at the TOP level of the bdl-envelope result (sibling of response, retry_payload, agent_type — not inside tool-generator's own response.create_result at all). Traced to its parent orchestration 62df9f7a: iteration 0 of the SAME loop was handler_agent=section-editor (handler_result_0 does carry a commit_sha somewhere in its tree); iteration 1 was tool-generator. tool-generator's OWN orchestration_states (owner_agent_type='tool-generator') shows ZERO instances of commit_sha anywhere in its tree, fleet-wide. So the value on that item is the whole-tree search borrowing iteration 0's unrelated commit — exactly bugs_open/334's defect, not a real tool-generator commit. Reported to the peer; not built as a migration.
